description: This ScienceDB collection digitises Sichuan and Chongqing soil types from the Second National Soil Survey. Six worksheets organise soil groups and subgroups, descriptive information, landscape positions, profile properties and county-level distribution. The depositing research team supplies XLSX workbooks under CC BY 4.0 for free reuse; its institution and precise sampling dates are not established in the inspected metadata. The records can guide soil-class parameter selection for agricultural-water, erosion and land-management simulations. Historical survey categories do not prove current local conditions, and county occurrence information provides limited detail for a specific construction site. Profile properties and mapped occurrence serve different modelling purposes. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
